description: Use this when the user wants a printable habit tracker ("habit tracker printable", "monthly habit tracker", "habit tracker pdf", "habit tracker template", "30 day habit tracker") for a month or several months. If the user pastes or uploads a list of habits (text or an image), first convert each one into the habits list, with days when a habit is only on some weekdays, then call. Builds a PDF grid with one row per habit and one box per day of the real month, weekday initials, weekend shading, week lines for Monday or Sunday weeks, grey boxes on days a habit is not scheduled, a Done column with the number of scheduled days, optional weekly pages, Letter or A4, landscape or portrait, 28 languages. Returns the month facts, each habit's scheduled day count, a preview and a PDF link. Does not send reminders, does not store ticks, and does not sync with habit apps.

blank_rows.description: Extra empty rows for habits written by hand. Default: enough to make 10 rows (at least 1), or 12 when no habits are given. Example: 0

color.description: Accent colour: a hex code like #0F766E or a name (violet, indigo, blue, teal, green, sage, red, pink, orange, amber, brown, slate, black). Default violet.

habits.description: The habits to track, one row each: a list like ["Drink 8 glasses of water", "Read 20 minutes", {"name":"Gym","days":"Mon, Wed, Fri"}] or pasted text with one habit per line. days limits a habit to some weekdays ("weekdays", "weekends", "Mon, Wed, Fri"); other days print grey. Up to 31. Omit for an empty tracker to fill in by hand.

language.description: Language for month names and weekday initials, e.g. en (default), pl, de, es, fr, it, pt, nl, sv, ru, uk, el, vi. Example: pl

month.description: First month as YYYY-MM or a name, e.g. "2026-11" or "November 2026" or "next month". Default: this month until the 15th, then next month.

months.description: How many months, one page each, 1 to 12. Default 1. Example: 3

notes.description: Print a notes area under the grid. Default true.

orientation.description: Monthly grid orientation: landscape (default, roomier boxes) or portrait.

paper.description: Paper size: letter or a4. Default letter for English, a4 for other languages.

title.description: Title printed at the top, e.g. "Maya's November Goals". Default: Habit Tracker.

totals.description: Print a Done column with each habit's number of scheduled days in the month, e.g. "/ 13". Default true.

view.description: monthly (one habits-by-days grid per month, default), weekly (one page per week with bigger boxes) or both.

week_start.description: First day of the week for week lines and weekly pages: monday or sunday. Default sunday for English, monday for most other languages.

name: generate_habit_tracker
title: Generate habit tracker
